description: Concordia College, Moorhead, MN INFORMED CONSENT STATEMENT PLEASE READ BEFORE COMPLETING THE SURVEY Hello, our names are Claire Clarke, Matthew Kindem, and Kaytlynn Ziegler. We are student researchers researchers in the department of psychology at Concordia College, Moorhead, MN. We would like to invite you to take part in our research concerning mind wandering. The purpose of this study is to investigate the link between mind wandering and reading comprehension. If you agree to take part in our research, you will be asked to fill out a survey that includes different passages to read and questions about the presented texts. Responding to the surveys should take about 30 minutes of your time. As a token of appreciation for your time, we will offer you the opportunity to enter a drawing for a $15 gift card upon completion of the survey. Your responses will be confidential. Your name will not be linked to your responses. We will not use your name or other identifying information in any reports of the research. Your anonymous data will be stored indefinitely on the Open Science Framework (OSF), for future analyses. Your identity and responses will be protected to the extent allowed by law. This means that they will be treated as confidential, unless you disclose information that is construed as threatening to yourself/others, or as indicative of abuse of minors/vulnerable adults. There are no foreseeable risks to you from participating in this research. We hope that the research will benefit research in our field by providing information about reading comprehension and mind wandering. We also hope that by participating in this study you learn something about what issues are of interest to psychologists, and how research studies are designed and conducted. There will be no costs to you, other than your time involved. Your participation in this research is voluntary. You are free to refuse to take part. You are free to withdraw your consent and discontinue participation in this study at any time by simply not responding to the questions. If you are participating in this study in order to receive credit for a class, rest assured that you may refuse to answer any question(s) that might make you feel uncomfortable and still receive course credit. No feedback on individual scores will be provided. You will be provided with a debriefing form when you have completed the survey. You may request a copy of the overall results of the research by calling, Claire Clarke, Matthew Kindem, Kaytlynn Ziegler, at 612-720-4940, 218-766-6231, 218-234-6877 or e-mailing at cclarke@cord.edu, mkindem2@cord.edu, kziegle1@cord.edu. If you have any questions about your rights or treatment as a participant in this research project, please contact Concordia College’s Institutional Review Board at (218) 299-3001, or send a letter to Concordia College, Institutional Review Board, Office of Academic Affairs, 901 8th St. S., Moorhead, MN 56562. Thank you. PLEASE FEEL FREE TO PRINT AND KEEP THIS SHEET FOR YOUR FUTURE REFERENCE Do you agree to participate in this study?
